args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Fix the ExportButton component so that the button is re-enabled if the export fails. Currently, if the fetch call returns an error, the button remains disabled (greyed out) because the `busy` state stays true. We propose adding a catch handler to the exportReport promise to reset the busy state to false on errors, allowing the user to try the export again without reloading the page.
